title: migrate: skips keys with name and email in separate UIDs
description: Debian keyring test (salsa 7dc4637): 6 live Debian Developer keys are skipped as 'no user ID with a usable name and email'. Each has a name-only UID plus email-only UIDs (' <x@y>', '<x@y>', or a bare 'x@y'); _name_and_emails wants one UID with both. 3 of the 6 also lose a reusable auth key pre-fill. pgpkeys af88128 has none today, but nothing stops a kernel key adopting this layout before the freeze. Proposed: when no UID has both, take the name from a name-only UID and emails from email-only UIDs (including bare addresses). Needs Mark's OK: it changes which UIDs count as identity claims.
